summary: Debounced (400ms) recursive fs.watch wrapper that feeds the keeper two separate routes: notebook .raw/*.jsonl events go to onNotebookRaw, everything else is filtered to indexed extensions and goes to the code batch. The non-obvious hazard, verified here: .html and .md ARE both present in EXTENSION_TO_LANGUAGE, so the keeper's own writes under .coldstart/ (it regenerates notebook/index.html and re-renders derived .md on every notes refresh) used to clear the extension filter and re-enter the code batch as 'repo changed' - a self-feeding loop that re-saved the cache and regenerated the view about every 5s. Fixed in #92 by the isUnderExcludedDir guard, which mirrors the walker's hidden/excluded-dir rules and is shared with patch so the rule cannot drift. The .raw/*.jsonl route is checked BEFORE the extension filter, which is why real note writes still refresh the view.
